name: B10-0550/2025 (ESN) – EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the EU position on the proposed plan and EU engagement towards a just and lasting peace for Ukraine
part_text:
This is a resolution stating the European Parliament's opinion; it does not change any law. It calls for a peace deal for Ukraine based on Ukraine staying neutral and outside NATO, with security guarantees from willing countries. It wants talks through the OSCE including Russia, no EU or NATO troops in Ukraine, strict audits of EU money sent to Ukraine, and better protection of minority languages there.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it sets out the Parliament's demands for a future peace deal.
- **Who it affects:** EU governments, Ukraine, Russia, and EU taxpayers funding aid.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU institutions and governments; they decide whether to act on it.
